title: Across the Grey
description: Aldous says the Hearthspire's flame was put out on purpose, by the High Keeper. The answers are on Cindermoor, and only the Tidewright ferry goes there — if it runs again now the Gull's Beacon is lit.

stages.text: Ask Mara whether the Tidewright ferry will put in at Saltmarrow again.
Mara has hung the green lantern outside her door. Watched harbors never get ferries — go about your business until you hear the horn.
The ferry's horn! A Tidewright ferry has put in at the Saltmarrow dock. Find its master.
Oda Farrow of the Slow Mercy has weighed your deed and will take you as far as Thornwold. Settle what's left in Saltmarrow, then tell her you're ready.
You have a berth on the Slow Mercy. She sails for Thornwold on the evening tide: tell Oda when you're ready to cast off.
